# fight_en.txt: dive_en.txt with 12,700-17,990 played like a person fights (the Shadows): the left stick
# round the four ways every 15 frames, CIRCLE (attack) 3 frames in every 5, CROSS (jump) once a cycle
# dive.txt for the English-patched disc (session 139, the default test disc since 2026-10-27:
# docs/next-session.md "The test disc"), through Dive to the Heart and on into Destiny Islands:
#   KH1_HOST_CD=go KH1_HOST_ISO=en.iso KH1_HOST_PAD=tests/host/pads/dive_en.txt KH1_HOST_FRAMES=91000 \
#   KH1_HOST_QUIET=1 KH1_HOST_TRACE=1 out/host/kh1-host
# en.iso: SHA-256 c8ee8c77..., 3,542,579,200 bytes. Two changes from dive.txt (the Japanese disc's):
#   25400       goto vm 2 (the box) for goto -9060 -14920: the box goes to (-9060, -14920) or
#               (-8280, -14920) by the collision group Sora stands on when the crate breaks (VM 0
#               pc 256: lib 379 func_001d3948 into variable 2560, 105 or not), which differs here
#   32400       no second CIRCLE: on this disc the CIRCLEs of 29,100-30,900 already reached the islander
#               beside Sora (VM 4), so a CIRCLE at 32,400 opened his talk again and the goto to the
#               next islander could not move Sora
# Then 70,000-77,500: Kairi's errand and the two logs; 77,600-91,000 (session 140): the cloth and the next room (comments below).
#   1250        waittitle (the title menu up; the Vita gets there 1,000-3,000 frames later); CIRCLE every 200 frames to 4600: New Game, its three pages, yes
#   4800-6600   stick up: Sora walks to the sword's pedestal (0, 580); 6600 CROSS jumps onto it
#   7000-7600   CIRCLE: the sword's lines, "this power?" yes, "what will you give up?"
#   8000-8800   off the pedestal, then goto (host/null/pad.c) round to the staff's (500, -300), CROSS
#   9200-10100  CIRCLE: the staff's lines, yes, "this is your form?" yes; the floor breaks (xs_dh_break.x)
#   12700-17900 CIRCLE every 30 frames: the attack tutorial and the Shadows
#   18100       goto toward the next station's door (-8670, -15430): its tutorial window (field icon)
#   18600-18800 UP (the command menu wraps to its 4th slot) + CIRCLE closes it; CIRCLE again: しらべる
#               on the door: "I can't open it like this" (script byte 3202 = 1)
#   19500-20800 goto the chest (-8670, -14250): the "?" command window (3203 = 2), UP + CIRCLE
#   21000-21900 UP + CIRCLE: 開ける opens the chest (save byte 780 = 3)
#   22400-25310 goto the crate (-8670, -14880) and three attacks, ten times: it breaks, the potion
#               (save byte 781 4 -> 5) and the box (-9060, -14920) appears
#   25400-26040 goto the box, UP + CIRCLE: もちあげる (lift); carried, then dropped: 2817 = 49
#   26300-27040 goto the door (-8670, -15300), UP + CIRCLE: しらべる opens it; walking in at ~28,000
#               loads the next area (the white, the SELECT look-around tutorial, はなす, a question)
#   32200-70000 (session 138; comments at each step below): the three islanders' questions, the
#               menu tutorial, the Shadows, the save point, the glass stairs, Darkside, and on into the
#               Destiny Islands opening
